howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会写并运行 esm Python SDK 代码:用 ESM3 生成或补全蛋白序列、按结构与功能条件做设计,用 ESMC 计算嵌入,以及预测结构和反向折叠。
howto.when: 当你直接调用 esm Python SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型 ID,或使用 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端与 ESMFold2 折叠流程时触发。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 补全这段带下划线占位符的蛋白序列
say.note: 本地加载开放权重做生成

say.text: 用 esmc_300m 给这几条序列算嵌入并返回结果
通过 Forge 用 esm3-medium-2024-08 预测这条序列的结构

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes and runs esm Python SDK code: generating or completing protein sequences with ESM3, designing from structure or function conditions, computing embeddings with ESMC, and predicting structures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work directly with the esm Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Complete this masked protein sequence with esm3-open
Compute embeddings for these sequences with esmc_300m
Predict this sequence's structure via Forge with esm3-medium-2024-08
